footnotes.text: 7. Elective (6 hours): Any course taken at the University or transferred in as a University course that does not essentially duplicate a course otherwise applied to the degree. footnotes.text: 8. Students in the College of Engineering and Computing are required to demonstrate proficiency in one foreign language equivalent to the 121 course by 1) a score of two or better on the foreign language placement test; or 2) completion of the 109 and 110 courses in FREN, GERM, LATN, or SPAN or completion of the 121 course in another foreign language. Students who do not place out of the GFL requirement may need to take additional hours to meet this requirement.
